coordinates: Engine world metres. Horizontal plane is x/z, y is up. Distance = hypot(dx, dz) (add dy from elevation for slant distance).
pixel_convention: px, py are continuous image coordinates in pixels of image_size_px with (0,0) at the top-left corner of the image (pixel centres at +0.5). x = a*px + b*py + c, z = d*px + e*py + f for pixel_to_world_affine [a,b,c,d,e,f]; world_to_pixel_affine is the inverse in the same form (px = a*x + b*z + c, py = d*x + e*z + f). If the image is shown scaled, scale px, py by image_size_px / displayed size first.
derivation: Each image is an orthographic top-down render of the map geometry (LOD0 render models of the day_2 client_project, from the pristine 0.26g resources.db) into exactly the square frame of the native 0.26g HUD minimap: hud.swf (build 2777) survarium.controls.Minimap _minimapProps {size, posX, posY} covers 2*size metres around (posX, posY), drawn with pixel = ((x - posX + size), (posY - z + size)) * width / (2*size) (Minimap.setProps / updatePlayerPos, the engine passes (x, -z)). Because the render rasterizes world coordinates directly, the scale is exact by construction; the native minimap bitmap (drawn by the developers for the same frame) lines up with the rendered buildings, and levelmap_min/max in level_01/02/04/05 client_projects equal the same frames.

level_01.name: Rudnya
level_01.orientation: image right = +x, image up = +z (top edge is z_max); same as the in-game HUD minimap

elevation.note: heights[row][col] in metres (engine y), row 0 = north edge (z_max), col 0 = west (x_min); cell centre = bounds origin + (col+0.5, row+0.5) * cell_m. Median terrain height per cell (terrain models; top surface where no terrain). Not floor heights inside multi-storey buildings.

object_overlay.meaning: respawn points / battery containers / battery spawners / charging stations of every mode project; floating = object stands > 0.5 m above all rendered geometry at its pixel (impossible if the transform is right); the controls run the same test with a deliberately wrong transform

native_minimap_alignment.search: scale 0.95..1.05 step 0.005, shift +-8 m step 0.5 m, at 2 px/m
